## Mapping Decisions

- **RECORD_TYPE from the source's own RECORD_TYPE** (PERSON on all 13); no organization names, no relationships.
- **Case fields are payload** so a resolved entity carries its investigation history (case number, referral date, fraud
  type, role in case, line of business, disposition). SIU_CASE_NUMBER (confidence 0.9) is unique per record and in no
  other source, so it is not a matching identifier.
- **Record 1021 (medical provider) has no name** in the source; kept as stated (address, email, SSN).
- **Cross-source shared-feature check:** same attribute names and quantities as earlier sources; no pairs to ask.

## Quality Notes

- Mapped-output quality 62.1 (completeness 48.7, format consistency 92.0, duplicate keys 0%). The bootcamper chose to move
  on below 70 at both the Phase 1 and the mapping gate.
- Coverage: NAME 92%, ADDRESS 77%, DOB 54%, EMAIL 38%, SSN 15%, DRLIC 8%, GENDER 8%.
- Mixed DOB formats kept verbatim (M/D/YY and M/D/YYYY). Some ADDR_LINE1 values hold a whole address
  ("638 Downey St, Salem, OR"), kept as the source states.
- Gates: analyzer exit 0, no warnings beyond low population; verbatim check passes; routing report drops nothing. The
  output is byte-identical to the source. These gates are structural; the semantic check is Data processing's match-key audit.
